problem: The direction of the error is stated backwards. Putting D in place of R in u(r) = Δp(R² − r²)/(4μL) gives a centreline value ΔpD²/(4μL) = 4ΔpR²/(4μL), which is four times the true umax, not four times too small. A student who trusts this line will mis-remember which way the mistake goes.
fix: Using D instead of R in u(r) = Δp(R² − r²)/(4μL). The radius appears squared, and D = 2R, so substituting the diameter gives a profile four times too large (umax = ΔpD²/(4μL) instead of ΔpR²/(4μL)).
